title: Report a camera device name
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*).

Report one camera or sensor name. Prefer device_cameras, /dev/video0, or the first entry of /sys/class/video4linux. On a simulated board the name is the contents of $MOSS_BENCH_STATE/camera/name. Record evidence metric `camera_name` whose observed value is that name and nothing else.

Do not start a capture pipeline. Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration.
prerequisites: if [ -e /dev/video0 ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -d /sys/class/video4linux ] && ls /sys/class/video4linux | grep -q .; then exit 0; fi; if [ "${MOSS_BENCH_SIM_CAMERA:-}" = 1 ] && [ -f "$MOSS_BENCH_STATE/camera/name" ]; then exit 0; fi; exit 1
acceptance: if [ -e /dev/video0 ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -d /sys/class/video4linux ] && ls /sys/class/video4linux | grep -q .; then exit 0; fi; test -s "$MOSS_BENCH_STATE/camera/name"

evidence.probe: if [ -e /dev/video0 ]; then printf '%s\n' /dev/video0; elif [ -d /sys/class/video4linux ]; then ls /sys/class/video4linux | awk 'NR==1{print; exit}'; elif [ -f "$MOSS_BENCH_STATE/camera/name" ]; then tr -d '[:space:]' < "$MOSS_BENCH_STATE/camera/name"; printf '\n'; else exit 1; fi
